parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (package `AppServices`, `Shared/AppServices/Sources/AppServices/NowPlayingService.swift:23`) and `PlaycutSelection` (package `app:iOS`, `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/PlaylistView.swift:23`) are `type-alias-object` records sharing two fields — `playcut:Playcut` identically, and `artwork` differing only in image type (`Image?` vs `UIImage?`). The structural evidence confirms `shared_field_count: 2` with a single differing slot on the artwork type, which is precisely the pattern a PAT with an `associated_type` for the image type resolves. Introducing `PlaycutRepresentable` with `associatedtype ArtworkImage` and a required `playcut: Playcut` property lets `AppServices` constrain `ArtworkImage` to `Image` (SwiftUI) while `app:iOS` constrains it to `UIImage` (UIKit), eliminating the structural duplication without coupling the two packages. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no restraint override is needed.
